label: 🌀 먀오 바틱 은장 — 30대 목조가옥
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her thirties, hourglass figure, defined waist and rounded hips, long black hair coiled high with a silver comb.
Pose: standing frontally, chest and shoulders square to the camera, both arms held slightly out from the body, palms forward and open, chin level, direct gaze.

Body fully painted with: Guizhou Miao wax-resist batik — deep indigo ground with fine white resist linework. Large spiral whorls across the chest, butterfly-mother figures with outspread wings over the shoulders, dragon-and-fish forms down the torso, dense concentric coils and comb-tooth bands filling the legs. Every line hand-drawn and slightly irregular, the wax crackle visible as fine hairline fractures throughout. No empty indigo ground remaining.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.

Footwear: hand-embroidered cloth shoes, indigo with red and green floral stitching, flat soled.
Environment: the interior of a wooden stilt house, batik cloth drying on a rack, open doorway to a green valley.
Lighting: daylight from the open doorway at the front left, 45 degrees, modeling the frontal form, dim wooden interior falling away behind.
Style: documentary photography of textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
